name: Bruneau electric
description: Bruneau Électrique Inc. is an ISO-certified electrical contractor. Well established in the construction sector, the company works on numerous large-scale projects in civil, industrial, institutional and commercial engineering.

name: Fives Services
description: Fives Services Inc. is a Canadian engineering and services company headquartered in Quebec. We specialize in handling and lifting equipment, such as overhead cranes, jib cranes, monorails, self-supporting structures, gantries and systems for the aluminum industry. We are specialists in the supply of fully automated lifting equipment. We offer complete industrial solutions for : - Annual audit, inspection and certification of equipment. - Engineering - Manufacturing, installation and commissioning - Modernization of existing equipment - Maintenance assistance and training - Fives Services Inc. is recognized for its quality products, reliable service and HSE excellence in a variety of industries.

name: Transport Laplante & Fils
description: In 1975, André and Serge Laplante founded TRANSPORT LAPLANTE et FILS. They followed their vision and together built what is today an ever-expanding company. With hard work, overtime sometimes totaling up to 100 hours a week, they braved such pitfalls as mechanical breakdowns, loss of merchandise, poor road conditions, traffic accidents, scheduling conflicts between customers and truckers, and not to mention the problems involved in crossing customs... With courage and conviction, they have guided their team through the storms of life, and are still renowned for the quality of their service to their ever-growing clientele.

name: AEC Autoénergie Canada
description: A Quebec SME in business for over 35 years, Autoénergie Canada inc. offers personalized service in the field of automatic control and the sale of ventilation equipment. Our experienced staff will ensure that your project is carried out to your complete satisfaction. The dynamism and competence of our team contribute to the success of our company.

name: Systemex Automation
description: Systemex Automation is an engineering, consulting and integration firm specializing in automated production systems. We deliver innovative technological solutions for a wide range of customers in the manufacturing and industrial process fields, drawing on a team of qualified experts in mechanics, electricity, automation, robotics, instrumentation, mechatronics and information systems.

name: Solumation
description: With over 1,000 automation projects completed since its foundation in 2002, Solumation operates in the field of industrial processes, offering unique, highly specialized services and solutions in process control and industrial IT. Our technical expertise and know-how in the food, pharmaceutical, chemical and metallurgical sectors enable us to offer solutions tailored to our customers' needs. As a growing company, we stand out for our team of passionate experts and our personalized services. We are recognized for the quality of the projects we deliver to our customers, year after year. Inspired by international standards, our mission is to develop and apply methods and standards for industrial process automation. The primary objective is to provide a highly specialized programming and design service. It's a service that demands strength in knowledge of the industrial environment and mastery of programming tools. Our experts combine solid practical experience in controls with an in-depth understanding of industrial process fields. This enables us to grasp our customers' operational challenges and design solutions tailored to their needs.

name: Fraco Products
description: Fraco is a global manufacturer and supplier of mast-climbing access systems. Products include work platforms, construction elevators, permanent industrial elevators and transport platforms.

name: Deflex
description: As North America's leading manufacturer of high-quality composite moldings, Deflex is committed to completing your projects on time. Our recognized expertise lies in the perfect blend of our knowledge of fiberglass and our mastery of manufacturing processes. Our solutions meet your technical specifications, are competitively priced, are delivered on time and exceed your expectations. Our motivated team thrives on challenges, and is entirely dedicated to serving our customers.

name: Lassonde
description: Lassonde Industries Inc. develops, manufactures and markets a wide range of ready-to-drink fruit and vegetable juices and drinks. The company is the second largest producer of non-refrigerated private label fruit juices and beverages in the United States and a major producer of cranberry sauces. In addition, the company develops, manufactures and markets specialty food products such as fondue broths and sauces and pasta sauces. It also imports selected wines from several countries of origin for packaging and marketing. It also produces apple cider and cider-based drinks.

name: Kopers
description: At Kopers, electricity and industrial automation are our playground. We're ordinary people with extraordinary values, true professionals who'll rise to any challenge. Proud, determined and talented, we've been in the game for over 60 years. We're real people who know what we're talking about. We reinvent our business every day, convinced that it's how we get ahead and make it to the top. When it comes to challenges, there's no excuse: we're real people who don't count the hours. 24/7 always game, we always find the solution and never give up. That's when we're at our best. At Kopers, we work together, convinced that every action makes a difference to the bottom line. That's why, throughout your project, we're committed to giving it everything we've got, and to giving it our all!

name: Matiss
description: Founded in 1995, Matiss has become a pioneer in industrial automation equipment and software. Over the years, the company has established itself and created two divisions: Matissoft (software activities in the agricultural sector) and MatissEquipement (robot implementation). With Matiss, you can develop your full potential. Your creativity, dynamism and talent will be recognized and valued, as they are at the heart of the success of their customers' automation projects. Their strength lies in their teamwork and their friendly spirit.

name: ACCS
description: Founded in 1992, ACCS has established itself as a major player in building intelligence solutions for the commercial, institutional and industrial real estate sectors. ACCS addresses all or part of its clients' operational needs and is dedicated to improving energy performance and occupant comfort. ACCS' automation, integration and optimization services improve overall building management and provide a unique experience for operators and users, whether they are customers, owners, tenants, visitors, etc.

name: Soteck inc.
description: Specialized in air treatment, automation, industrial refrigeration and energy efficiency, Soteck helps industries in the food sector to control their production conditions in order to obtain an optimal product quality.

name: PCI Automation
description: Since its creation in 2001, PCI Automatisation Industrielle offers consulting services in industrial automation systems integration. Thanks to our flexibility and our multidisciplinary and experienced team, we can quickly adapt to the needs and reality of our customers. PCI is able to carry out all your projects, from the simplest to the most complex. Their goal: to become an extension of their customers' engineering department.

name: Frontmatec
description: Frontmatec, a world-renowned international company, develops customized automation solutions for the food industry. From single machine sales to complete projects, Frontmatec offers unique, state-of-the-art solutions. Frontmatec is the result of the merger of six companies. With this combination of strengths, they are able to offer unique complete solutions that will create considerable added value for customers. With operations in Europe, America and Asia, Frontmatec serves a wide range of high-profile customers, from world-class manufacturers to large international food processors.
